extra.message: Authentication credential decision has no effective rate limit, lockout, backoff, or CAPTCHA control.
The Express development error handler, which returns the full stack trace to the requesting client, is mounted unconditionally: app.use(errorHandler());

POST /update/:id (app.js:63, no isLoggedIn) passes attacker-controlled req.params.id into Todo.findById and overwrites/saves todo.content; no check ties the object to the requestor, allowing modification of arbitrary todos by ID.

Deep-merge of client-controlled `req.body.message` with no dangerous-key rejection: the merge recurses into `target[key]`, so a `__proto__` key in the request payload reaches `Object.prototype`.
Password stored or matched in cleartext — no hashing is applied anywhere in this module; use bcrypt/scrypt/argon2.
A template variable is substituted into the `@if` helper's `cond` attribute, which Dust evaluates as JavaScript, so the value is parsed as expression syntax rather than data.

The session middleware issues its session cookie without an effective Secure attribute, so it may travel over cleartext HTTP.
